lib_dir.description: Path to the directory containing oddjob helper programs. Usually set by the package installer.

pid_file.description: Full path to the file where the daemon writes its process ID.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads. Set to 0 for no limit (but system resources still apply).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to the system log (syslog/journald). Turn on only for troubleshooting.

run_dir.description: Directory for transient runtime files used by the daemon and its helpers.

chroot.description: If true, chroot into LibDir before running services — only use if security hardening is required and services support it.

user.description: System user under which the oddjobd daemon process runs. Should have minimal privileges.

group.description: System group under which the daemon runs.

session_tracking.description: Enable PAM session tracking. Required for services that need to interact with user sessions (e.g., mounting user home directories).

services.description: List of custom or optional services that oddjob can execute via D-Bus. Each entry defines a service executable and optional overrides.

name.description: Unique identifier for the service (e.g., 'mkhomedir', 'create-home'). Used as prefix for config keys.

path.description: Absolute path to the helper program executable for this service.

enabled.description: Whether this service is allowed to be invoked via D-Bus.

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for service execution before termination.

user.description: Optional system user to run this specific service (overrides the global User setting).
